intent.summary: Milestone lifecycle mechanics and ceremony on the hierarchical model (B-double-prime): project.json is the Lv4 parent container — phase entries gain additive task_ref and completed_at snapshot fields written at mark-done/archive time, resume composes parent plus resident child state (no dedicated parent state file, state.json schema untouched, no levelless shell ever created); implement milestone close-with-parked, fix the P0 phase insertion order, close the shipped v1.0.0-dev milestone with parked P2/P3 carried over, open the publicize milestone, and re-home P2/P3 onto it unchanged (their execution stays with the phases themselves, after P23).

requirements.text: Milestone lifecycle mechanics and ceremony on the hierarchical model (B-double-prime): project.json is the Lv4 parent...
milestone open writes project.json {name, opened_at}; name slug-sanitized at identity; open refuses while an unclosed milestone exists; close stamps closed_at
milestone close [--carry-parked]: validate, render, dual-channel snapshot, stat-verify, one atomic wipe under lock; parked only under flag; pending carried; vacuum close needs --empty
selective wipe = five-class disposition (parked verbatim, pending carried, done+owned+host wiped, null-phase wiped, ghost wiped); guard = surviving classes; report prints class counts + row IDs
close backups: default dry-run; execution needs --yes or approve record; pre-close project.json copied to both channels as dated preclose + view snapshots; standalone close synthesizes close-home
snapshot channel two carries views as rendered on disk — copy rendered files, never re-render at close, manual regions survive verbatim
archive path stamps task_ref (stable across re-entry) and completed_at; mark-done stamps completed_at only; PROJECT_SCHEMA_VERSION 1->2 with shape checks; emptyProject seeds milestone null
repo Lv4-ness = tracked marker .gos/project/lv4.json OR project.json existence; marker travels with clones; state.project consumers re-pointed; legacy wrappers get one-shot retirement prompt
stateless resume composes parent view with machine-greppable NO ACTIVE TASK banner; marker without local state.json downgrades claim hint to clone warning
phase move <from> <to>: from takes name-prefix + optional --expect index guard; refuses active targets; one-time P0 -> index 0 reorder before the v1.0.0-dev close
archive slug prefix switches from PKG.version to stored milestone name for NEW archives only; historical basenames never rewritten; T10:281 assertion updated same change
gos-project archive-milestone.sh replaced in-repo by refusing stub (exit 1, prints use gos milestone close); SKILL.md rows re-point to new verb family
pre-close normalization: bare-prefix phase fields on decision/requirement rows normalized to canonical names via rename reference-rewrite before the wipe predicate
spec truths registered mechanically: plan task 0 registers all truths via gos truth add before first BUILD commit; VERIFY includes truths>0 closeout check
ceremony: close v1.0.0-dev (parked P2/P3 + pending P21/P22/P23 carried), open publicize; P2/P3 re-homed unchanged (park_reason verbatim)

review_findings.issue: init --project=<name> and the documented positional name form never routed to the bootstrap lane (isProject exact-matched --project only); stray task-lane positionals silently created junk null-level state
validatePhase accepted task_ref dot-segments (./..), letting a hand-edited project.json redirect the close archive channel outside milestone-record/
three T114 crash-window approval assertions were vacuous (console.log checkmarks never incremented FAIL), leaving consume-once guarantees untested
retireWrapperState deletes state.json before guardCwd takes the lock; read-class commands can mutate; dry-run close can prompt-delete
close-time canonicalization persists rewritten bare phase refs on carried survivors (verbatim contract latent gap; live data unaffected — 0 bare refs among carried rows)
closeSnapshot target-exists refusal has no recovery story or cleanup hint (same-day same-name close bricked)
closeReadyHint fires in the closed-not-reopened gap (allDone ignores milestone state)
wipe-window crash between saveProject and autoRenderViews leaves stale views with no repair hint
init --project --fresh resets project.json but leaves stale rendered views (openMilestone skips render on brownfield)
stateless Lv4 repo cannot record the MILESTONE-CLOSE approval (cmdApprove dies noActiveTask); ceremony on a fresh clone would brick at runbook step 4
>50 decisions-index warning duplicated inline in status.cjs (with-state + stateless paths) instead of a shared helper
milestone open silently ignores stray flags and prints no brownfield warning (init --project refuses the same shape loudly)
